paywall_plan_variant.description: Capslock plan id shown when the paywall was not opened with a deeplink plan id.

force_update.description: Boolean. When true, Android Play in-app update is required on resume and iOS UpgradeAlert hides Later.

is_app_under_maintenance.description: Boolean. When true, a full-screen maintenance gate replaces the app navigator.

maintenance_title.description: Optional headline on the maintenance screen.

maintenance_message.description: Optional body copy on the maintenance screen.
